original_test_intent: Verify the BMC Web Operations reboot control accepts one authorized reboot, deliberately removes management availability, returns within the approved interval and restores the specified BMC services without changing host power/workload state.
original_method: Identify BMC/WebUI build and target; preserve logs and active-task/session baseline; prove independent console/recovery; authenticated operator or browser automation navigates the exact Operations page and clicks Reboot BMC once; an independent observer timestamps WebUI/session/IPMI/Redfish loss and staged recovery; after service readiness, verify identity, networking, authentication, WebUI, IPMI, Redfish, sensor/SEL and host invariance; stop without retry on timeout.
manual_activity: Owner approves the outage/window and exact reset interface; operator/agent uses the approved WebUI path once while an independent path observes recovery.
required_inputs: BMC firmware/WebUI/browser and exact target identity
Whether source WebUI action is mandatory or IPMI/Redfish is formally equivalent
Expected disconnect, network, daemon and full-function readiness timeouts
Critical-task exclusion, alternate console/recovery and post-reset function checklist
safety_requirements: Confirm no update/recovery/critical BMC task is active
Use an independent recovery/observation path and one reset only
Bound each readiness phase and preserve host/workload state
Stop on timeout, identity change, repeated flapping or host impact; never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture pre-state and navigate/execute only the approved reboot control
Timestamp transport/session/service loss and staged recovery
Do not substitute interface, reset through only path, retry, power-cycle host, clear logs or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve reset interface and WebUI coverage requirements
Approve disconnect/readiness timeouts and service checklist
Approve outage window, active-task exclusions and recovery
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: IPMI cold reset or Redfish Reset exercises BMC reboot but bypasses the source's WebUI Operations control and cannot prove that UI action functions unless equivalence is approved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the exact BMC Web Operations reboot control once, with independent reachability/service probes; use API only as approved observation or equivalent stimulus.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: WebUI Operations path, disconnect/reconnect, restored BMC functions and 10/10-minute estimate remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Drive one authenticated WebUI reboot while a separate observer measures transport, authentication, API/UI and sensor-service readiness milestones.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact coverage-path distinction, active-task guard, staged timeouts, host invariance and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Ping return alone can precede BMC application readiness; API-triggered reboot does not prove the WebUI control path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The initiating browser session will disappear, DNS/ICMP can recover before Redfish/IPMI/WebUI, and loss of the only management path can require physical service.

project_override_considerations: If UI automation is unsupported, engineering may authorize a separately documented API equivalent only if the goal is reboot behavior rather than the Operations page; otherwise retain manual WebUI click coverage.
expected_evidence: BMC/WebUI target identity, approval and no-critical-task baseline
Exact Operations-page action or approved equivalence record
Post-reset identity/functions/sensors/SEL and host power/workload invariance
Alternate recovery status and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define a WebUI-triggered BMC reboot with temporary disconnect and restored function.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The controlled reboot is conditionally executable once target, interface, timeout and recovery inputs are approved.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2282 Wistron-BMC-00878-V003: approve BMC/WebUI/browser build and whether the exact Operations -> Reboot BMC path is mandatory or IPMI/Redfish is formally equivalent; define expected disconnect, network, authentication, IPMI, Redfish, WebUI and full-function readiness timeouts/checklist within the 10-minute estimate; approve no-critical-task gate, one-shot outage window, independent console/recovery, host-state invariance and failure handling.

review_improvement: Preserves the source's WebUI operation and distinguishes mere network return from complete BMC function recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BMC reboot has layered availability: link and ping may return before authentication, IPMI, Redfish, sensor providers and WebUI are ready. The source explicitly names the Web Operations control, so an IPMI/Redfish reset is not automatically equivalent; it tests the reboot mechanism while bypassing the UI path. Because the initiating channel is expected to disappear, observation and recovery must be independent and retries prohibited until the BMC owner diagnoses a timeout.
